title: Construction Grammar Test Harness — evidence-bounded baseline
scope_warning: This is a baseline audit harness, not a complete Arcane parser. BLOCKED and NOT YET TESTED are not passes.

results.test: Homographs are either disambiguated by a proven grammar or explicitly approved
results.detail: 255 non-empty entries; 2 duplicated spellings; ra: radian [UNIT; Shared; CANON] vs TARGET-path [FUSED-REF; Performed; CANON (v2.0)]; re: 4 [DIGIT; Shared; CANON] vs TARGET-surface [FUSED-REF; Performed; CANON (v2.0)]
results.basis: Direct exact-string check of the supplied Phase 5 lexicon CSV. Duplicate forms may be intentional, but no executable grammar test currently proves contextual disambiguation.

results.test: Lexicon form and gloss are populated
results.basis: Direct CSV completeness check; does not validate meaning.
Checks only that each entry declares a status; does not promote proposals to canon.

results.detail: All ten digit glosses map to their documented forms.
results.basis: v3.0-L digit table; exact presence check against supplied CSV.

results.detail: Rule is documented, but the source pack does not define a complete token grammar or executable reference-state transition model; no valid end-to-end fixture can yet be parsed.
results.basis: Phase 4 §3.3 states persistence; Phase 5.16 recovery matrix identifies full parser as missing.

results.detail: Expected behaviour is implied by “persists until replaced”, but replacement token boundaries, scope encoding and invalid replacement handling are not fully specified.
results.basis: Phase 4 §3.3; exact v2.0 morphology unavailable in supplied archive.

results.detail: Intended order is documented (reference → spatial role/vector → Feet → couplings → quantity → control → release), but token classes and legal repetition/cardinality rules are incomplete.
results.basis: Phase 4 §3.3. This is an ordering contract, not a parser pass.

results.test: Foot morphology parses frame + parameter vowel + optional relation coda
results.detail: The shape is documented, but the exact legal frame inventory, vowel-to-property mappings and coda inventory are not sufficiently canonical to validate arbitrary Feet.
results.basis: Phase 4 §§3.3 and 12 mark parameter mapping provisional and exact v2.0 details unrecovered.

results.detail: Phase 4 labels the mechanical/thermal/electromagnetic/chemical/biological/informational/mana mappings PROVISIONAL; the harness must not silently treat them as canon.

results.test: Numeral closure and dimensional units are validated in a complete expression
results.detail: Phase 4 says numerals close with units and SHO closes dimensionless numerals, but this harness lacks the operator signature table and parser needed to validate expression-level quantities.
results.basis: Phase 4 §6 G-2; formal operator signatures and full parser are not included as an executable grammar.

results.test: Hand-flame example is fully well-typed and feasible
results.detail: Known verdict remains: tokenised and partially structured; not proven well-typed and not physically validated. No result is inferred from lexical legality.
results.basis: Phase 4 §8 explicitly says no whole-spell grammar parse was run and required energy, extent and coupled matter are unspecified.

results.test: Physical mechanism and conservation are independently checked
results.detail: No resource/mechanism feasibility engine or canonical spell IR is present in the recovery archive.
results.basis: Grammar Consistency Test Register T-013/T-014; Phase 5.16 recommended separate syntax and physical-feasibility layers.

results.test: Vernacular parser and naturalness are validated
results.detail: The Phase 5 samples are word-defined and mechanically checked, but no machine parser or listener results are included.
